title: Colts' loss to previously winless Titans seals this regime's death
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver recap the Indianapolis Colts' inexcusable loss to the previously winless Tennessee Titans. Indy's horrible performance confirms that this regime is dead. Now, it's just a matter of when everyone is getting fired. Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company.
